dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: We have a new wine today. A glass for you?

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: This is Djafar Tavern, the best in Port Ormos! Our boss here can get hold of any good wine!

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Nearby merchants, tourists, sailors... and my old friends from the Eremites all come here to indulge in drinking from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: And there's also the tasty appetizers. Personally, I think you can have them as meals, even without drinks!

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Take care, and please do come again!

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Hehe, sorry, I don't look like someone who's been in the Eremites, do I?

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: But I was a veritable mercenary there! I could punch sea monsters in the face!

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Well, that was a joke. It's hard to beat a sea monster. But to deal with a couple of drunks, it's as easy as pie.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Even when there's something I can't handle, I have the gorgeous, gentle, and powerful Roshana here.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Anyone who annoys her will come to a bad end.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Shh, quiet, don't let her hear you!

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Every time I say something like that, she thinks I'm nagging and gives me the cold shoulder. I don't want that.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: To be honest, I left the Eremites for here because of Roshana.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: She is such a visionary! I enjoy much more freedom here than freelancing for the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: But don't tell her I said that. I'll bribe you with some nice cooking!
